title: Mean normalized per-episode cost of the Reorder Optimization Agent (C2) across 10 seeds in the 100-SKU experiment (first 30 of 200 episodes shown). Each seed's episode costs normalized by its own episode-1 (random-policy) cost.
relation_to_rop_eoq: convergence to ~0.41 of random-policy cost corresponds to ~0.87 of the ROP-EOQ cost (Table tab:results-overview)
